supersede.why: One part only, so scripts/supersede_check.py --parts integrate=partial is not a candidate. agent-manager runs existing agent CLIs on a private tmux socket. It does not watch outside sources, it does not keep a deduped tool catalog with stage cards, and it does not score tools on I0-I4. The internal catalog package is a model list for those CLIs. A package name is not suite coverage. Do not adopt it in place of this repo. Do not add a watchlist row.
